> 5 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin under Federation Issuers. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Federation Issuers

- [Archive Federation Issuer](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_issuers/archive.md): Archive a federation issuer.
- [Create Federation Issuer](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_issuers/create.md): Register an OIDC issuer that Anthropic will trust for workload identity federation in your organization.
- [Get Federation Issuer](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_issuers/retrieve.md): Retrieve a federation issuer by its ID (`fdis_...`).
- [List Federation Issuers](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_issuers/list.md): Include archived resources. Defaults to false.
- [Update Federation Issuer](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_issuers/update.md): Partially update a federation issuer.
